summaries.Romania: Romania's new government under Luca Niculescu faces immediate fiscal pressures with over 12 billion lei in unpaid magistrate salaries and must balance pension indexing against deficit reduction. The country continues to struggle with inflation (6.5% in September, highest in EU) while advancing infrastructure projects like the A7 highway and Mintia power plant.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation is accelerating with personalized cancer vaccines showing promise alongside traditional treatments, while regulatory scrutiny intensifies on fraud and AI governance. The sector faces workforce challenges and shifts toward integrated care models addressing affordability and patient access.
summaries.Tech: Apple's iPhone Duo foldable launched to massive demand with pre-orders selling out within hours at $1,999, while the broader ecosystem expanded with HomeView smart displays and new AI partnerships. The quarter showed AI becoming central to product strategy across hardware makers, from Meta's Muse models to autonomous vehicle capabilities.

items.title: România rămâne și în septembrie țara cu cea mai mare inflație din UE. Rata anuală, aproape dublă față de media europeană (Eurostat)

items.title: After a melanoma diagnosis, mRNA cancer vaccine delivered a patient hope — and a path forward
